Minor scheduling changes within the same week only

options: To impose personal values on the client
To encourage the client to adopt the therapist's goals
To avoid the imposition of personal values on the client
To terminate immediately without discussion in all cases

mcqs.question: According to Ethics Standard on termination, psychologists terminate therapy when it becomes reasonably clear that the client:
options: Has attended a fixed number of sessions
No longer needs the service, is not likely to benefit, or is being harmed by continued service
Disagrees with the therapist on a minor issue
Requests a referral to another provider only

mcqs.question: Psychologists may terminate therapy in which additional circumstance?
options: When threatened or otherwise endangered by the client or another person with whom the client has a relationship
When the client asks questions about termination
When the client makes progress toward goals

options: A termination letter in every case with no discussion
Pre-termination counseling and suggest alternative service providers as appropriate
A guarantee that the client will never need therapy again

options: Get defensive if the client is unhappy
Blame the client if they are difficult
Never abandon a client without warning and be compassionate, clear, and direct
Argue with the client to ease the therapist's feelings

options: It records the end of therapy as well as the reasons for termination and can clarify the nature and reason for termination
It replaces the need for any record keeping
It is used only to bill the client for final fees
It protects the therapist by blaming the client for ending therapy

Explain that the job is to ensure excellent care, that they cannot meet the client's needs, and offer a referral to a better-fit therapist
End therapy without warning or explanation
Continue therapy despite inability to meet needs

options: Play on the client's fears to continue treatment
Present the issue in stigmatizing terms
Abandon the client without any notice
Send them a termination notice using the client's preferred method of communication, ideally via several channels

mcqs.question: For terminating therapy with a child, what does the handout emphasize?
options: Termination should never be discussed until the last moment
Discuss termination at the beginning of therapy, prepare the child as far in advance as possible, and explain clearly in age-appropriate terms why therapy must end
Children should not be allowed to share feelings about termination
Parents should not be involved in discussing termination

mcqs.question: For each substantive contact with a client, the record should include:
